svg.aria-label: A population of 4,266 order lines drawn as a grid of small squares, with 50 of them picked at random and highlighted. The sample's average estimates the population's average, with some uncertainty.
svg.title: Population and sample: a random sample of 50 order lines from all 4,266.

g.text: Each square stands for about three order lines. The dark ones are a random sample of 50.
